validation_policy.unicode_normalization: fullwidth ASCII U+FF01..U+FF5E and ideographic space U+3000 only; preserve superscripts, subscripts, circled numbers, Roman numerals and units
validation_policy.semantic_symbols: preserve route arrows, check/cross marks, plus/minus, warning and prohibition symbols
validation_policy.exact_content_duplicate_key: clean text with whitespace removed; punctuation, case and semantic symbols preserved
validation_policy.dedup_weight_policy: retained records=1.0; removed duplicates are absent from dataset_clean and listed in rejected_records.jsonl with reason near_duplicate_of:<canonical>
validation_policy.duplicate_group_rule: transitive closure of near_duplicate_pairs; canonical = earliest input record; later members removed
validation_policy.main_target: Each of 3 scenic areas: >=1 official route and >=5 travelogues
validation_policy.minimum_target: Each of 3 scenic areas: >=1 official route and >=3 travelogues
